title: Hoshino Ichika — Our New Song's Goal〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This seems like a good place to take a break...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Rin
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everything's starting to come together nicely.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think so too. We're even running a little bit ahead of schedule.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. If we keep this up, we'll have time to look at things in finer detail.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But our sound has more volume to it right now because we have Rin and Len here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just try to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're so stoic.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right? It's like they're all totally focused on succeeding when it counts!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
How did your last show go?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right. We've only had a chance to talk to Len and MEIKO about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It was better than any of our other shows♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, the best of three.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That doesn't matter. If it's the “best” it's the best☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you tell me more about your show♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like how you performed or what it was like there!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What it was like there...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We usually play towards the beginning of the lineup, so we have to work a little to warm up the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In terms of the whole show or event, we get them when they've been there for a bit but it's not like they're bouncing off the walls or anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's true, but we're still new to this, so it may be to our benefit to be up there earlier rather than later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'd run the risk of buckling under pressure if we play later, but not play very well in front of a fresh audience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I agree.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I didn't feel as nervous this time.
I felt like I had a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Playing our new song probably helped with that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Totally♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool! I wanna play in a show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you guys do a huddle before you go on stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What do you usually do?
Can you show me♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sure♪
Ichi, Hona, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi usually leads us during our huddle, but we all make a peace sign with our hands and put them in the middle, like this...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, they make a star!
That's so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A star? Like the name of your band?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki loves coming up with stuff like this. That includes doing a huddle and forming a star with our hands.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
When did you come up with those?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd been thinking about doing a huddle after we knew that we were gonna be performing in a show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I came up with the star idea the day before that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just huddling up and doing a chant seemed kinda boring, so I searched for some ideas on my phone♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but the video I saw had five people in it, so I was worried that it would look funny when we tried it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Five...? Oh, that makes more sense! Then you'd get a five-pointed star!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: True, but Saki, weren't you using both hands just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Pretty good considering how nervous I was before our show, right♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I dunno. What's wrong with a four-pointed star?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! No!
It's gotta be five!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think Sakki's budging there♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way! Here, just look...
If we try it with just four...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, four doesn't look quite right.
I guess five is better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. Sure, four looks like a star...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Specifically, a ninja star...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
See?! Seeeee...?!
Ichi gets it!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's what I was talking about!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A ninja star, huh...?
I mean, it's still a star, so I don't see any problems with it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I do!
It's gotta be a real star!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm guessing this all just comes down to what hypes you up the most, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So the most passionate person's opinion, in this case, may be best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. After all, Saki did come up with doing a huddle first.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's true.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll become second nature as we keep performing in shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I'd love that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we'll have to remember to do it before our next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!
